name: Elowen and Tegan

intro.text: ELOWEN: Halt, pilgrim! I'm guarding the Tor on behalf of Keeper Morwen. And my cousin, who's behind you.
TEGAN: Hold on, hold on, wellies, torch, lantern. I'm ready! Morwen says every visitor gets a warm-up. Two on one is the warm-up.

win: ELOWEN: Hm. The hill approves. TEGAN: And my lantern's out. Mind the step.
after: Keep going up. It gets steeper, then it gets a view. The Keeper does a lovely cuppa afterwards.
